rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Welcome, mo! Even if you're Rex's
friends, no freebies, mo! I won't
go easy on you, mo!

rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Oh, welcome back, Rex, mo! You
are always welcome here, mo!

rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0003
rows.name:
The salvage buyback lineup changes
a little, mo. Check back often, mo.

rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0004
rows.name:
You're very diligent, mo. I wish
my layabout son would learn from
your example, mo.

rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Rex, it's been a while, mo. Lately,
Hiyokkoo comes by more than
anyone else, mo.

rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0006
rows.name:
People really do grow, mooo...
My layabout son doesn't, though.

rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0007
rows.name:
Even with Alst in such a crisis,
believe it or not, my layabout son
still won't leave the house, mo.

rows.label: tlk006001_01_msg0008
rows.name:
Once Alst is at peace, I want him
to become Rex's apprentice, mo.
I'm counting on you, mo!
